visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video utilizes a vertical split-screen format. In the upper frame, a black cat with stern, narrowed yellow eyes sits against a pink tiled wall. It wears a yellow-and-white striped apron and a small yellow bow on its head. The cat holds a silver handheld shower head in its right paw, aimed downwards. To the right, a silver shelf holds bottles of Dove and Aesop products. (2) In the lower frame, a fluffy Corgi dog is seen from a rear perspective inside a shower stall with light blue tiles. The dog is heavily covered in white soap suds. A thick stream of water pours from the top of the frame directly onto the dog. The Corgi shakes its head and torso vigorously, scattering soap and water droplets. A shelf on the right side of this stall contains three pump bottles in pastel shades. (3) Both frames remain static in terms of camera movement, depicting a looped animation of the cat seemingly showering the dog, separated by social media user interface overlays including heart and comment icons.
